title: VeloraOS 1.11.0 - Device Continuity
releaseNotes: Adds secure Device Continuity pairing with QR codes or one-time codes, mutual approval, trusted-device aliases and immediate revocation.
Adds end-to-end encrypted direct file transfer with incoming approval, progress, cancellation, retry and SHA-256 verification.
Adds opt-in shared clipboard and activity handoff for chats, Knowledge items, files and VeloraOS workspaces.
Adds online presence, incoming transfer and handoff inboxes, audit history and Command Palette device actions.
Adds responsive desktop and mobile Continuity experiences with private-network HTTPS enforcement and replay-resistant signed requests.
